As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Across Europe, industrial manufacturers turn to Rubix for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) solutions that keep their plants running. The company combines a pan-European distribution network - supplying everything from bearings and power transmission to fluid power, machining tools, PPE, and general maintenance products - with the expertise of its technical competence centers. These teams design and deliver value-added services such as automation and robotization projects, on-site engineering support, and condition monitoring to cut downtime and waste.
